Questions 27–30

What opinion do the students give about each of the following modules on their veterinary science course?

Choose the correct answer and move it into the gap.

27 Medical terminology

28 Diet and nutrition

29 Animal disease

30 Wildlife medication

A Tim found this easier than expected.
B Tim thought this was not very clearly organised.
C Diana may do some further study on this.
D They both found the reading required for this was difficult.
E Tim was shocked at something he learned on this module.
F They were both surprised how little is known about some aspects of this.

transcript.en: So,Tim,we have to do a short summary of our work experience on a farm.
transcript.zh: Tim，我们必须对我们在农场的工作经历做一个简短的总结。

transcript.en: Right. My farm was great,but arranging the work experience was hard. One problem was it was miles away and I don't drive.
transcript.zh: 好的。我的农场很好，但筹划这个工作经验很困难。一个问题是它离我很远，但我不会开车。

transcript.en: And also,I'd really wanted a  placement for a month,but I could only get one for two weeks
transcript.zh: 还有，我很想安排一个月的工作，但我只能找到一个两周的工作。

transcript.en: I was lucky,the farmer let me stay on the farm so I didn't have to travel. But  finding the right sort of farm to apply to wasn't easy
transcript.zh: 我很幸运，农场主让我暂住在农场里，这样我就不用通勤了。但是要找到合适的农场并不容易。

transcript.en: No,they don't seem to have websites,do they. I found mine through a friend of  my mother's,but it wasn't easy.
transcript.zh: 确实不容易，他们好像没有网站，是吧。我是通过我母亲的一个朋友找到的，但不太容易。

transcript.en: No.
transcript.zh: 的确是这样。

transcript.en: My farm was mostly livestock,especially sheep. I really enjoyed helping out with  them. I was up most of one night helping a sheep deliver a lamb.
transcript.zh: 我的农场主要是饲养牲畜，特别是绵羊。我真的很喜欢帮助它们。我有一晚几乎整夜没睡，在帮一只羊接生。

transcript.en: On your own?
transcript.zh: 你自己吗？

transcript.en: No,the farmer was there,and he told me what to do. It wasn't a straightforward  birth,but I managed.
transcript.zh: 不，农场主在那里，他告诉我该怎么做。这不是一个简单的分娩，但我成功了。

transcript.en: It was a great feeling to see the lamb stagger to its feet and  start feeding almost straightaway,and to know that it was OK.
transcript.zh: 看到小羊踉踉跄跄地站起来，几乎马上就开始吃东西，而且知道它没事了，这种感觉很好。

transcript.en: Mm.
transcript.zh: 嗯。

transcript.en: Then another time a lamb had broken its leg,and they got the vet in to set it,and  he talked me through what he was doing. That was really useful.
transcript.zh: 还有一次，一只小羊的腿断了，他们请来了兽医进行治疗，他告诉我他在做什么。这真的很有用。

transcript.en: Yes,my farm had sheep too. The farm was in a valley and they had a lowland  breed called Suffolks,although the farmer said they'd had other breeds in the past.
transcript.zh: 是的，我在的农场也有绵羊。农场在一个山谷里，他们有一个叫Suffolks的低地品种，尽管农场主说他们过去也有其他品种。

transcript.en: So were they bred for their meat?
transcript.zh: 那么，他们是为了吃肉而饲养的吗？

transcript.en: Mostly,yes. They're quite big and solid.
transcript.zh: 大多数情况下，是的。它们相当大，很结实。

transcript.en: My farm was up in the hills and they had a different breed of sheep,they were Cheviots.
transcript.zh: 我的农场在山上，他们有一个不同品种的羊，是Cheviots羊。

transcript.en: Oh,I heard their wool's really sought after.
transcript.zh: 哦，我听说它们的羊毛很抢手。

transcript.en: Yes. It's very hardwearing and they use it for carpets.
transcript.zh: 是的。它非常耐磨，他们用它来做地毯。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 嗯。

transcript.en: I was interested in the amount of supplements they add to animals' feed nowadays. Like,even the chickens got extra vitamins and electrolytes in  their feed.
transcript.zh: 我对现在的动物饲料中添加的补充剂的数量很感兴趣。比如，即使是鸡，它们的饲料中也有额外的维生素和电解质。

transcript.en: Yes,I found that too. And they're not cheap. But my farmer said some are  overpriced for what they are.
transcript.zh: 是的，我也发现了这一点。而且它们并不便宜。但我的农场主说，有些价格过高。

transcript.en: And he didn't give them as a matter of routine,just  at times when the chickens seemed to particularly require them.
transcript.zh: 并且他并没有常态化提供补充剂，只是在鸡似乎特别需要的时候才给它们。

transcript.en: Yes,mine said the same. He said certain breeds of chickens might need more supplements than the others,but the cheap and expensive ones are all basically  the same.
transcript.zh: 是的，我的农场主也这么说。他说某些品种的鸡可能比其他鸡需要更多的补充剂，但便宜的和昂贵的补充剂，基本上都是一样的。

transcript.en: Mm.
transcript.zh: 嗯。

transcript.en: So did your farm have any other livestock, Diana?
transcript.zh: 那么你的农场还有其他牲畜吗，Diana？

transcript.en: Yes,dairy cows. I made a really embarrassing mistake when I was working in the milk shed.
transcript.zh: 是的，乳牛。我在奶棚工作时犯了一个非常尴尬的错误。

transcript.en: Some cows had been treated with antibiotics,so their milk wasn't  suitable for human consumption,and it had to be put in a separate container.
transcript.zh: 一些奶牛接受了抗生素治疗，所以它们的牛奶不适合人类饮用，必须放在一个单独的容器里。

transcript.en: But  I got mixed up,and I poured some milk from the wrong cow in with the milk for  humans,so the whole lot had to be thrown away. The farmer wasn't too happy  with me.
transcript.zh: 但是我搞混了，我把一些来自错误奶牛的牛奶倒在了人类食用的牛奶中，所以整批牛奶不得不被扔掉了。农场主对我不太满意。

transcript.en: I asked my farmer how much he depended on the vet to deal with healthproblems.
transcript.zh: 我问过我的农场主，他在处理牲畜健康问题时有多依赖兽医。

transcript.en: I'd read reports that the livestock's health is being affected as farmers  are under pressure to increase production.
transcript.zh: 我曾经读到的报道说，由于农民面临增产的压力，牲畜的健康受到了影响。

transcript.en: Well,he didn't agree with that,but  he said that actually some of the stuff the vets do,like minor operations,he'd be  quite capable of doing himself.
transcript.zh: 嗯，他不认同这个说法，但他说，实际上兽医做的一些事情，比如小手术，他自己就有能力做。

transcript.en: Yeah. My farmer said the same. But he reckons vets' skills are still needed.
transcript.zh: 是的。我的农场主也这么说。但他认为，仍然需要兽医的技能。

transcript.en: Now we've got to give a bit of feedback about last term's modules – just short comments, apparently. Shall we do that now?
transcript.zh: 现在我们要对上一学期的课程做一些反馈 - 就是简短的评论。我们可以现在做吗？

transcript.en: OK. So medical terminology.
transcript.zh: 好的。嗯，医学术语。

transcript.en: Well,my heart sank when I saw that,especially right at the beginning of the  course. And I did struggle with it.
transcript.zh: 当我看到它时，我的心沉了下去，尤其是在课程开始的时候。而且我确实在为这个问题挣扎过。

transcript.en: I'd thought it'd be hard,but actually I found it all quite straightforward.What did you think about diet and nutrition?
transcript.zh: 我本以为这很难，但实际上我发现这一切都很简单。你对饮食和营养有什么看法？

transcript.en: OK,I suppose.
transcript.zh: 好吧。

transcript.en: Do you remember what they told us about pet food and the fact that there's such limited checking into whether or not it's contaminated?
transcript.zh: 你还记得他们告诉我们的关于宠物食品以及对其是否受到污染的检查如此有限的事实吗？

transcript.en: I mean in comparison with  the checks on food for humans – I thought that was terrible.
transcript.zh: 我的意思是，与人类食品的检查相比 - 我认为这很糟糕。

transcript.en: Mm. I think the module that really impressed me was the animal disease one,when we looked at domesticated animals in different parts of the world,like  camels and water buffalo and alpaca.
transcript.zh: 嗯。我认为真正让我印象深刻的课程是动物疾病，当时我们研究了世界不同地区的驯化动物，如骆驼、水牛和羊驼。

transcript.en: The economies of so many countries depend on these,but scientists don't know much about the diseases that affect  them.
transcript.zh: 许多国家的经济都依赖于这些动物，但科学家对影响它们的疾病了解不多。

transcript.en: Yes,I thought they'd know a lot about ways of controlling and eradicating those  diseases,but that's not the case at all.
transcript.zh: 是的，我以为他们会知道很多控制和根除这些疾病的方法，但完全不是这样。

transcript.en: I loved the wildlife medication unit. Things like helping birds that have been caught in oil spills. That's something I hadn't thought about before.
transcript.zh: 我喜欢野生动物药物治疗科。像帮助那些被卷入石油泄漏的鸟类的事情。这是我以前没有想过的事情。

transcript.en: Yeah,I thought I might write my dissertation on something connected with that.
transcript.zh: 是的，我觉得我可能会写与此相关的论文。

transcript.en: Right. So actually I was thinking something...
transcript.zh: 对。所以我在想......
